meta.name: google-cloud-waf-cost-optimization
meta.description: Generates cost optimization guidance for Google Cloud workloads based on the Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework (WAF). Use this skill to evaluate a workload, identify cost requirements and constraints, and provide actionable recommendations for build, deploy, and manage the workload cost-efficiently in Google Cloud.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估工作负载并给出成本优化建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在 Google Cloud 上运行工作负载并想降低成本
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate workloads and provide cost optimization recommendations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run workloads on Google Cloud and want to reduce costs

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据 Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework 的成本优化支柱，评估你的工作负载，识别成本需求和约束，并提供可操作的建议，帮助你在 Google Cloud 中经济高效地构建、部署和管理工作负载。
howto.when: 当你询问如何优化 Google Cloud 工作负载的成本，或要求评估工作负载的成本效率时触发。

say.text: 帮我评估一下我的 Google Cloud 工作负载的成本效率。
say.note: Claude 会询问相关问题并给出优化建议。

say.text: 如何降低我的 Google Cloud 计算资源成本？
say.note: Claude 会提供具体的优化策略。

say.text: 检查我的 Google Cloud 项目是否符合成本优化最佳实践。
say.note: Claude 会使用验证清单进行评估。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude evaluates your workload based on the Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework's Cost Optimization pillar, identifies cost requirements and constraints, and provides actionable recommendations to build, deploy, and manage your workload cost-efficiently in Google Cloud.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask how to optimize costs for your Google Cloud workload or request a cost efficiency assessment.

say_en.text: Evaluate the cost efficiency of my Google Cloud workload.
say_en.note: Claude will ask relevant questions and provide recommendations.

say_en.text: How can I reduce costs for my Google Cloud compute resources?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest specific optimization strategies.

say_en.text: Check my Google Cloud project against cost optimization best practices.
say_en.note: Claude will use the validation checklist to assess.
